relevance_note: Family case series with individual-level detail; 'Gene sequencing verified that the proband carried the mutation c.963G > A in the LAMP-2 gene', plus two affected relatives with DD.
method_note: Read by hand; the JSON was assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory and every span checked verbatim by script. Table 1 has patients as columns (column headers: 'Proband (III-1)', 'Mother of the proband (II-2)', 'Aunt of the proband (II-3)'); Tables 2 and 3 have patients as rows. Labels III-1, II-2, II-3 are the paper's own. Only the proband has a printed LAMP2 variant; II-2 and II-3 are 'patients with DD' found 'According to the clinical data', with no stated genetic test, so they have no variant rows. Inheritance of the proband's variant is not reported (mother affected but no stated testing). Zygosity not stated. The father of II-2 and II-3 ('had died 20 years earlier') and 'the other family members' (normal ECG/echo) get no rows: neither tested nor stated affected, no labels. Lab values without the ↑ symbol (e.g. II-2 CK 66, II-3 AST 30.1/ALT 13.2/CK 49.7) are not recorded as normal: the legend defines only ↑ (elevation); the absence of ↑ is not defined as normal, and '2 out of 3 patients had severe liver function abnormalities' is an unnamed count. NT-pro-BNP '/' for III-1 treated as not reported. Checklist 'intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties' left not reported for II-2 and II-3: intellectual retardation and cognitive dysfunction are stated absent but learning difficulties are not addressed (narrow vs broad rule); feature rows record the exclusions. Heart failure left not reported for all (NYHA class and reduced LVEF are reported but the paper never says heart failure). LVH not reported for II-3 (Table 2 HCM 'No' does not address LVH). II-2: Table 2 'Hyperintensity T2 signal' No and Fig. 3 'no obvious hyperintensity on T2 fat-saturated images' versus 'The T2 values of the left ventricular free wall were elevated (F)' were treated as different measures (signal vs mapping), not a contradiction; same for II-3. Group statements 'in all the DD patients' (elevated T1/ECV) and 'in all three patients' (normal septal T2) name this family's three patients, so they were applied per person with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Proband was previously reported in ref [7]; ages are at this report. No stacked cells in this paper. The supplementary file is a CARE checklist with no patient data.
